fact: The Gabon DGI announced on 18 August 2025 a new e-tax portal for online tax declaration, so taxpayers can file returns online.
The Gabon DGI announced on 18 August 2025 that the e-tax portal also takes online payment of taxes.
The DGI flyer says eTax is being integrated into Gabon Connect in October 2026, with a single online monthly salary declaration (eEmployeur) opening 21 October for 440 DGE firms.
